Name: (CP) Junimos as Kirby
Author: CandyConstellation
Description:
Want little Kirby cuties running around in your game? Then this is the mod for you!
This mod affects the Junimos in the Community Center, around your farm, in cutscenes, and in Junimo Kart. There are also separate options to change the Junimo Hut into Kirby’s house, the Junimo plushes into Kirby plushes, and furniture to have Kirby instead of Junimos. Pairs well with my Monsters as Enemies from Kirby mod.

Tip: You can add a mineral to your Junimo Hut to change the Kirbies into that particular color (vanilla behavior).

No relation to Manakete_Smoocher’s "Junikirby for Content Patcher"—I didn’t even notice it existed until I was already half way done with this project—but make sure to their mod some love, too!
